messages:
Alicia: Heads up — master CI is red for runtime tests. Job: https://ci.internal/12345
Failed test: serve_token_alignment_test (runtime/serve/tests) on linux-x86. Anyone able to take a look? Seen in the last merge + flaky recurrence. :sob:

ci-bot: Build 12345 failed on shard 7. Failing target //runtime/serve:serve_tests
Last lines:
```
E   AssertionError: token order mismatch
.../runtime/serve/tests/serve_token_alignment_test.py:87
Seed: 82734
```

ben: @Alicia I can grab this. Quick note: let's avoid blanket reruns, they mask bisect signals. :thinking_face:

chloe: I can do a bisect today. Does anyone have a reliable local repro command?

marco: I repro locally with: `bazel test //runtime/serve:serve_tests --test_output=errors --runs=100 -j1` — seed 82734 fails about 1/30 runs for me. Seems timing-dependent (more likely on x86 CI workers).

nayan: That matches my hunch — looks like a race between KV cache eviction and token alignment producing nondeterministic ordering. Increasing test timeouts hides it but that would be a bandaid.

riley: Quick diagnostic plan: (1) add short debug logs around kv::flush and alignment path, (2) run the failing seed under `--runs` locally, (3) if repro, do a minimal bisect to find offending change. I'll push a debug-only branch.

chloe: Sounds good. Plan for this thread: 1) @riley push debug logs PR, 2) I run a bisect with the failing seed (82734) and reduced noise, 3) create flaky ticket and mark CI as blocked if it's a regression. Please don't trigger auto reruns until we have bisect results. :eyes:

ci-bot: Noted — auto-reruns paused for job 12345 per eng-runtime request.

riley: Pushed debug branch: https://git.internal/r/riley/serve-debug-logs — it adds timing logs and an assert guard to catch the ordering the test hits. Example log snippet:
```
[serve] ts=1612345678.123 flush:start id=0x3c; kv_len=128
[serve] ts=1612345678.123 align:enter seq=42 from=kv; pending_flush=true
[serve] ts=1612345678.124 flush:end id=0x3c; kv_len=0
[serve] ts=1612345678.124 align:exit seq=42 order=unexpected
```
I'll run 200 iterations against seed 82734 and attach results.

chloe: If that repros consistently with the logs, I'll bisect between the last two releases. If it's a behavioral regression, we'll open a PR to fix ordering in the alignment path. Otherwise we may add a more deterministic handshake in tests.

Alicia: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Assigning to eng-runtime oncall and adding SRE if we see infra flakiness. I've created FLKY-401 in the flaky-tests board and linked the CI job. Keep updates here.

riley: Ran 200 loops; reproduced ~7 failures. Attaching raw logs to FLKY-401. Next step: chloe bisecting now.

chloe: Bisect in progress — I'll post the culprit commit-ish when found.

ben: Thanks team. If you want me to slot a hotfix PR (if bisect points to a specific change), I can own the PR and ship a quick revert/fix. :+1:
